desc:
Welcome to Hero Ability Arena! 🦸‍♂️💥

Choose your Hero Ability and head straight into the arena! Fight other players to earn Cash, unlock new Hero Ability, and dominate the game!

🔥 Game Features 
• 21+ Playable Characters (Superman, Spider-Man, Iron Man,Captain America & more!) 
• Unique ability movesets & combat combos 
• Fast-paced PvP arena combat 
• Earn Cash by fighting and getting streaks 
• Regular updates with new Superheroes, bosses, and powers!

🎮 Supported Devices
 PC, Mobile, Tablet, Xbox, and PlayStation

⭐ Like and Favorite the game for more updates, codes, and new Heroes !

⚠️ Rules
 No exploiting, cheating, alt farming, or bug abusing. Breaking the
rules will lead to a permanent ban.

🏷️ TAGS 
Superhero, Hero, Powers, Abilities, Superpowers,Battlegrounds, Arena, PvP, Fighting, Combat, Avengers, Marvel, DC,
